Curry Laksa.note: Dried shrimp, belacan and sambal belacan = crustaceans; tau pok = soy; default mixed noodles: yellow mee = wheat + egg, bihun = rice. Coconut milk is not milk. Chicken, no pork or alcohol, pork-free branch = halal by ingredients. Described as spicy.

Seafood Curry Laksa.note: Prawns, dried shrimp, belacan = crustaceans; squid = molluscs; fish balls = fish; tau pok = soy; yellow mee = gluten + egg. Spicy.

Penang Asam Laksa.note: Mackerel broth and flakes = fish; hae ko (prawn paste) = crustaceans. Thick rice laksa noodles, no wheat. Spicy.

Vegetarian Curry Laksa.note: Stated without shrimp, belacan or fish; tau pok and beancurd skin = soy; default bihun (rice), so no gluten or egg; coconut milk is not milk. Merchant tags vegan. Spicy.

Penang White Curry Mee.note: Cuttlefish = molluscs; prawns and dried-shrimp chilli paste = crustaceans; tau pok = soy; yellow mee = gluten + egg. Chilli paste served on the side with no heat word = 1.

Penang Prawn Mee.note: Prawn-head broth and prawns = crustaceans; hard-boiled egg and yellow mee = egg; yellow mee = gluten. Stated no pork. Spicy.

Lor Mee.note: Yellow noodles = wheat + egg; dark soy sauce = soy + gluten; beaten egg; fish cake = fish; Shaoxing wine = sulphites + gluten, not halal (rule h); black vinegar with wheat = gluten. Stated not spicy.

Fish Ball Kuey Teow Soup.note: Fish sauce, fish balls, fish cake = fish (fish balls assumed wheat-free, as v3). Flat rice noodles, no gluten. Chicken broth, not vegetarian. Not spicy.

Nasi Lemak Bungkus.note: Belacan sambal = crustaceans; ikan bilis = fish; roasted peanuts; egg. Coconut milk is not milk. Spicy.

Kaya Toast.note: White bread = wheat; butter = milk; kaya = egg + coconut milk.

Half-boiled Eggs.note: Eggs; light soy sauce = soy + gluten. White pepper is not spicy.

Kaya Toast Set.note: Default components: kaya toast (wheat, butter, egg), half-boiled eggs with light soy (soy + gluten), hot kopi with condensed milk (milk). Other set drinks are modifiers.

Otak-Otak.note: Fish paste; egg; belacan = crustaceans; coconut milk is not milk. Mildly spicy = 1. Sold out on this branch.

Fried Wantan.note: Wheat and egg wrappers; prawn filling = crustaceans; light soy = soy + gluten; sesame oil = sesame. Sweet chilli dip with no heat word = 1.

Popiah.note: Wheat skin; egg strips; tofu and sweet bean sauce = soy (+ gluten); crushed peanuts. Stated no dried shrimp. Chilli sauce on the side = 1.

Cucur Udang.note: Prawns = crustaceans; wheat flour batter. Chilli sauce on the side = 1.

Chee Cheong Fun with Curry.note: Rice flour rolls (no wheat); curry with dried shrimp = crustaceans; sweet soy sauce = soy + gluten; sesame seeds. Stated no pork despite the Chinese name 猪肠粉. Mild curry = 1.

Cendol.note: Coconut milk, gula melaka, rice-flour jelly, red beans: no regulated allergen. Merchant tags vegan.

Kopi.note: Condensed milk. No butter roast stated.

Kopi O.note: Black coffee with sugar; no butter roast stated, so no milk (rule o applies only where stated).

Cham.note: Coffee and tea with condensed milk.

Barley Lime.note: Pearl barley = gluten (v7 Barley Water; the English line governs over 薏米).

Limau Asam Boi.note: Lime juice and salted sour plum; no sulphites stated.

Fresh Coconut.note: Coconut is not a tree nut.

Tiger Beer.note: Barley malt lager = gluten; alcohol = not halal. Vegan as v7 Asahi / v8 Tsingtao.
